description: Details of an Australian education provider by CRICOS provider code (e.g. "00113B") or oneuedu.com school URL: names, public/private, scale, Group of Eight flag, description, English entry requirements, campuses, upcoming intakes, average offer time, the RTO (vocational registration) linked to it, page url and a ready-made courses search url. Use search_courses with schoolCode to list its courses and get_rto for the RTO record.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

school.description: CRICOS provider code such as "00113B", or a school page URL / slug ending in the code.

name: get_school
title: Get provider (school) details
